examples.text: Sembra vivere in riva al lago.
examples.en: She seems to be living by the lake.

examples.text: Un uomo stava pescando sulla riva opposta.
examples.en: A man was fishing on the opposite bank.

examples.text: Diversi uomini stanno pescando dalla riva del fiume.
examples.en: Several men are fishing from the riverbank.

examples.text: Sembra che viva in riva al lago.
examples.en: She seems to be living by the lake.
